title: Senior Grid Connection Engineer
description:
**Senior Grid Connection Engineer** 




**€70\.000 \- €100\.000** 




**Hamburg** 




**Permanent** 




  





 Our client, a globally recognised engineering organisation with a strong reputation for delivering high\-impact renewable energy and energy infrastructure projects, are currently hiring for a Senior Grid Connection Engineer. The company in question are at the forefront of the energy transition, playing a critical role in some of the most important grid infrastructure upgrade projects across Germany and wider Europe. Their work is central to enabling large\-scale integration of renewable generation into modern power systems.
 



  





 This opportunity is ideal for an experienced electrical engineer who thrives in a collaborative, close\-knit team environment and has a proven track record across utility\-scale renewable energy and energy transition projects. You’ll be someone who enjoys tackling complex, modern challenges around grid integration, with a strong interest in ensuring systems meet evolving grid code requirements. A passion for applying technical expertise and a forward\-thinking mentality energy projects will set you apart.
 



  





**Key Requirements:** 



* A formal qualification within electrical, power, or renewable energy engineering
* A minimum 5 years experience of working within utility\-scale energy transition projects
* Demonstrable experience working on grid\-connected generation systems or power system studies
* Extensive experience working to grid code standards VDE\-AR\-N 4105/4110/4120
* Hands\-on capability with simulation and modelling tools such as DIgSILENT PowerFactory and/or MATLAB



  





 This is an opportunity to join one of Germany’s most reputable engineering organisations, supporting major renewable energy and grid infrastructure developments shaping the future of the energy sector. Even if you’re not actively searching but are motivated by meaningful challenges and career progression, apply now for a confidential conversation.
